# dagsterplus_team (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ team by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_team" "data_engineering" {
  name = "data-engineering"
}

output "team_id" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_team.data_engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the team to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The team ID assigned by Dagster+.
